description: This Java class 'JsonPathMatcher' extends 'BodyMatcher' and provides functionality to match JSON content using JSONPath expressions. It includes methods for constructing the matcher, performing matches, and handling logging and exceptions.

classes.name: JsonPathMatcher
classes.description: A matcher class that uses JSONPath expressions to match JSON content within HTTP bodies, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: JsonPathMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JSONPath matcher and handles compilation errors with logging.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Performs the JSONPath match against a given string, logs differences, and handles errors.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the matcher string is blank.

methods.name: fieldsExcludedFromEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Returns fields excluded from equals and hashCode methods, annotated with @JsonIgnore.
